messages.content:
Draft graph.json for this:

Show how checkout works in our shop: the shopper pays in the web app, the order service reserves the stock, the payment provider takes the payment, and the shopper gets an email when the order is confirmed.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file, for editors. Ignored by explAIn-it.

id.description: Stable id, used by edges, zones and the storyboard.

kind.description: Sets the default size, height and colour.

zone.description: The id of the zone the node sits in.

category.description: A palette category name; a node's defaults by its kind, an edge's and a zone's to the accent.
A palette category name; a node's defaults by its kind, an edge's and a zone's to the accent.

graph.description: The structure of a flow. Mermaid is generated from it.

assumptions.description: What you assumed where the description left it open, each in a sentence.

questions.description: At most 2 questions whose answers would change the draft; none when nothing would.

reply.text: {"graph":{"version":1,"title":"Checkout in our shop","nodes":[{"id":"shopper","label":"Shopper","kind":"actor"},{"id":"web_app","label":"Web app","kind":"service","icon":"app-window","zone":"shop"},{"id":"order_service","label":"Order service","kind":"service","zone":"shop"},{"id":"stock","label":"Stock","kind":"database","zone":"shop"},{"id":"payment_provider","label":"Payment provider","kind":"external","icon":"credit-card"},{"id":"email_service","label":"Email service","kind":"external","icon":"mail"}],"edges":[{"id":"pay","from":"shopper","to":"web_app","label":"Pay"},{"id":"place_order","from":"web_app","to":"order_service","label":"Place order"},{"id":"reserve","from":"order_service","to":"stock","label":"Reserve stock"},{"id":"take_payment","from":"order_service","to":"payment_provider","label":"Take payment"},{"id":"payment_taken","from":"payment_provider","to":"order_service","label":"Payment taken"},{"id":"confirm","from":"order_service","to":"email_service","label":"Order confirmed"},{"id":"confirmation_email","from":"email_service","to":"shopper","label":"Confirmation email"}],"zones":[{"id":"shop","label":"Our shop"}]},"assumptions":["The stock is kept in a database that the order service updates directly.","The payment provider is an external service, and the order service calls it after the stock is reserved.","The confirmation email is sent by a separate external email service when the order is confirmed.","The shopper's payment is entered in the web app and passed on to the order service, which handles the rest."],"questions":[]}
